title: Strange as it seems, much as I like
summary: Đưa một phần câu lên đầu để nhấn mạnh hoặc nhượng bộ: Strange as it seems…, Much as I like…, Try as I might…, Gone are the days…

dialogue.en: Are you moving back to your hometown?
Yes. [[Much as I love]] Saigon, it's too expensive.
dialogue.vi: Ừ. Dù rất yêu Sài Gòn nhưng ở đó đắt quá.

dialogue.en: [[Strange as it may seem]], I'd like to move here!
dialogue.vi: Nghe lạ nhưng mình lại muốn chuyển vào đây!

dialogue.en: Really? [[Try as I might]], I couldn't save any money.
dialogue.vi: Thật à? Cố mấy mình cũng không tiết kiệm được đồng nào.

dialogue.en: [[Gone are the days]] when rent was cheap.
dialogue.vi: Thời giá thuê nhà rẻ qua rồi.

dialogue.en: Exactly. [[Tired as I am]] of the city, I'll miss it.
dialogue.vi: Đúng vậy. Dù chán thành phố, mình vẫn sẽ nhớ nó.

sections.heading: Tính từ / trạng từ + as + S + V
sections.rule: **Tính từ / trạng từ + as / though + S + V** = **dù… đến đâu** (nhượng bộ, nhấn mạnh). Trang trọng hơn although.

examples.en: [[Strange as it seems]], he never learned to swim.
examples.vi: Nghe lạ nhưng anh ấy chưa bao giờ học bơi.

examples.en: [[Tired as she was]], she kept working.
examples.vi: Dù mệt, cô ấy vẫn làm tiếp.

examples.en: [[Hard as I tried]], I couldn't open it.
examples.vi: Cố mấy tôi cũng không mở được.

check.prompt: ___ as it sounds, the plan might work.

sections.heading: Much as I like…, Try as I might…
sections.rule: **Much as + S + V** = dù rất… (thích, muốn); **Try as + S + might / may** = cố mấy cũng.

examples.en: [[Much as I like]] him, I can't lend him money.
examples.vi: Dù rất quý anh ấy, tôi không thể cho anh ấy vay tiền.

examples.en: [[Try as I might]], I couldn't remember her name.
examples.vi: Cố mấy tôi cũng không nhớ tên cô ấy.

check.prompt: Much as I ___ to help, I don't have time.

sections.heading: Gone are the days, Here comes, On the wall hung…
sections.rule: Đưa **trạng ngữ nơi chốn / tính từ** lên đầu và **đảo động từ chính** lên trước chủ ngữ (văn kể chuyện, nhấn mạnh): **Gone are the days…, Here comes the bus.**

examples.en: [[Gone are the days]] when we wrote letters.
examples.vi: Thời viết thư tay đã qua rồi.

examples.en: [[On the wall hung]] a large painting.
examples.vi: Trên tường treo một bức tranh lớn.

check.prompt: Gone ___ the days when phones had buttons.

mistakes.wrong: Strangely as it seems, he agreed.
mistakes.right: Strange as it seems, he agreed.

mistakes.wrong: Tired as was she, she continued.
mistakes.right: Tired as she was, she continued.

mistakes.wrong: Much as I like him, but I won't marry him.
mistakes.right: Much as I like him, I won't marry him.

mistakes.wrong: Try as I might, but I failed.
mistakes.right: Try as I might, I failed.

mistakes.wrong: Gone is the days of cheap rent.
mistakes.right: Gone are the days of cheap rent.

options: Hard as I tried, I failed.
